title: pilosella flagellaris subsp. hahnii
intro: Pilosella flagellaris subsp. hahnii, commonly known as Mouse-ear Hawkweed, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the dandelion tribe within the sunflower family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its potential to treat various health issues, such as inflammation, infections, and skin conditions, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella flagellaris subsp. hahnii are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which help to soothe and heal the skin. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
